scope: Explicit automatic Word/shared Markdown review add/delete feedback; cloud authenticated historical feedback adaptation. Does not generalize to PDF/image deletion or automatic learning.

producerMatrix.feedback: FN per actual new entity; empty/no actual addition noop
FN one representative with occurrence count
FP one representative for actual current live overlap deletion; prior ignore still a live entity
FP grouped by normalized type/text; user-added counter differs but feedback record still exists

producerMatrix.producer: ordinary decision keep / noop / PDF / image
producerMatrix.feedback: none; no cause inferred from a generic diff

sourceOrdering.bridge: Preload205 directly invokes feedback:add-batch; no payload filter or own catch.
sourceOrdering.batch: Mu.addFeedbackBatch appends records, save(), then addAuditLog(); audit persists on a later save.
sourceOrdering.learning: getAllMemories.filter result unused; no updateMemoryFromFeedback call.
sourceOrdering.storage: Source JSON optional key XOR obfuscation; our AEAD/RLS is a declared safety adaptation.
sourceOrdering.dedupe: Source reserves documentName|entityType|start|end|FPFN before RPC, retains keys on failure. Preserved; false/timeouts count zero success in our UI.

ownContracts.prepare: Current permission, revision, server slot IDs, source/canonical hashes and strong UTF16 anchors. Before/after sanitized against trusted current records.
ownContracts.semantic: Canonical source content and corrected semantic text stored separately; client cannot invent original text.
ownContracts.submit: User-bound authenticated plan; current permissions and same source/canonical required. Prepared revision cannot be in future; later ordinary review revisions accepted as nonapproval historical feedback.
ownContracts.idempotency: Immutable record IDs plus locked encrypted feedback state; same plan parallel submits do not duplicate.
ownContracts.save: Dispatcher flush is bounded by independent15s transport, failure swallowed as failed receipt; approval is never fabricated and no learning occurs.
ownContracts.audit: Transactional audit is deliberately not source save-before-audit scheduling.
ownContracts.typeHide: Persistent ignore+hidden metadata retaining all slots; restore clears hidden flags and requires fresh pending confirmation. Final source birth checked server-side; no feedback for hide/restore.
